blocks.text: Bring timeless elegance and everyday comfort to your living room with the Colleton Sofa, designed for those who appreciate classic style with modern durability. Featuring traditional details like a roll arm frame and nailhead trim, this leather sofa adds sophistication to any space while offering a cozy spot for family gatherings or quiet evenings. Upholstered in 100% top grain leather in all seating areas with skillfully matched faux leather on the sides and back, it delivers the luxurious look and feel of genuine leather with added practicality. Each hide showcases natural variations such as healed scars and grain patterns, making every piece unique. Built for lasting support, the reinforced frame and platform foundation system resist sagging three times better than traditional spring systems, maintaining a smooth, wrinkle-free appearance over time. Plush foam cushions wrapped in poly fiber provide comfort you can sink into, while exposed feet with a faux wood finish complete the classic design. Perfect for traditional or transitional decor, this sofa combines style, strength and comfort for years of enjoyment.

items.label: TRADITIONAL SOFA
items.value: Sporting classic elements including a roll arm frame with nailhead trim, this couch provides here-and-now relevance. But you’ll love the look for years to come

items.label: QUALITY MADE
items.value: Built with a sturdy corner-blocked frame. Back cushions are attached; seat cushions are loose. Exposed feet with faux wood finish

items.label: AFFORDABLE LUXURY
items.value: Genuine leather covers inside areas such as the back, seat & arm cushions; matched faux leather covers the remaining areas

items.label: COMFY SEATING
items.value: Measures 92" W x 40" D x 39" H. Seat height: 20". Seat depth: 22". Arm height: 26". Distance between arms: 72”. This furniture is perfect for curling up and reading or dozing

items.label: ARRIVES ASSEMBLED
items.value: Ready for instant enjoyment in the living room or family room. Fits through doorways 36” or wider. Set it with a recliner, accent chair or loveseat to complete your space
